description.p: MerMark Editor is an open-source Markdown editor with built-in Mermaid diagram support. Write in a WYSIWYG view or in the raw Markdown source, and your files stay plain .md on your disk.

ul.li: GitHub Flavored Markdown with tables, task lists, footnotes, math and syntax-highlighted code
Mermaid flowcharts, sequence, class, state, ER, Gantt and many more diagram types, editable in place
Marp presentations with a live slide preview and fullscreen present mode
Multi-root workspaces with a file tree, quick switcher and full-text search
Split view, tab comparison, change tracking and automatic reload of files changed on disk
Export to PDF and Word using your chosen document style
Optional AI assistant for local Ollama models and OpenAI-compatible servers
English, Polish, German, Chinese and Japanese interface

description.p: The Flatpak build runs in a sandbox: Claude Code and Codex CLI installed on the host system are not visible to it.

description.p: Saving from the visual editor keeps your Markdown as you wrote it.

ul.li: Changing a word changes only that line in the file
Fixes for links and code examples that could be damaged on save

description.p: Clicks and selections in the Code view land on the right line when the editor is zoomed in.
Newer AI models, one-click CLI updates and synced scrolling in the split view.

ul.li: Newest Claude Code and Codex models show up in the AI panel without waiting for an app update
Code and preview panes scroll together again

description.p: Security update: bundled components with reported issues were updated.
Page margins, a keyboard-friendly file tree and better printing.

ul.li: Editor margins: Small, Medium, Large or Pageless
Move through the workspace file tree with the keyboard
Print preview split into real pages, with headers, footers and page numbers on Linux
Fixes for quotes, auto-save in the code view and formulas in printouts

description.p: Keyboard shortcuts and menus work again on Windows and Linux, including the Minimal layout.

ul.li: Command palette, Go to heading, Find next/previous and Replace
Change, add or remove keyboard shortcuts in the settings
Print from the File menu and a Japanese interface
Print and PDF margins are respected on Linux

description.p: Seven document styles with per-style overrides, used for both the editor and PDF and Word exports.
Cleaner paragraphs and reliable pasting of chat answers that contain tables.
Native application menus and a Minimal layout preset.
